summary.zh: 把 AngularJS 应用渐进迁移到新版
summary.en: Move from AngularJS to modern Angular incrementally

description.zh: 采用混合运行模式，逐个组件改写并更新依赖注入，让旧应用和新框架并行工作。适合 AngularJS 项目需要逐步升级、无法一次重写的场景。
description.en: Runs AngularJS and Angular side by side, rewriting one component and injection point at a time so the old app keeps working. Use it when a full rewrite is not an option.
